source_file: 10189892_2024_FRANKLIN v. THE JERSEY CITY HOUSING AUTHORITY_njd
notes: Pro se FHA claims against HUD dismissed on sovereign immunity/standing grounds; no adjudication of disability pleading merits.

source_file: 10212330_2020_Harmony Haus Westlake, LLC v. Parkstone Property Owners Association, Inc._txwd
notes: FHA disability discrimination/reasonable accommodation claims dismissed because plaintiff failed to allege conduct was 'because of' handicap; retaliation claim survived.

source_file: 10252595_2023_United States of America v. City of Milwaukee_wied
notes: FCA case involving HUD/FHA-related certifications; government failed to tie specific regulatory provisions to specific false certifications; not a disability-pleading failure in the conventional sense.
Pro se plaintiff didn't state disability, describe accommodation requested, or allege defendant's refusal; FHA claim conclusory; leave to amend granted.
No refusal to accommodate pleaded; benign ESA documentation inquiries not discriminatory statements under § 3604(c).
Despite multiple amendments, pro se plaintiff didn't allege disability, protected status, or discriminatory motive; hip/knee pain mentioned without necessity/accommodation request.

source_file: 10603183_2025_JONES v. FEATHERSTONE CONDOMINIUM HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION INC_gamd
notes: Retaliation claim lacks adverse action; reasonable accommodation claim doesn't describe disability, necessity link, or refusal.
Rule 8 failure; string citation of statutes without tying facts to any FHA theory; shotgun pleading dismissed with leave to amend.
Pro se vague and conclusory FHA allegations; plaintiff fails to connect facts to any FHA element or cognizable theory.

source_file: 10707819_2025_Presidential Candidate Number P60005535, also known as Ronald Satish Emrit, and Presidential Committee_Political Action Committee_Separate Segregated Fund (SSF) Number C00569897 d_b_a United Emrits of Ameri
notes: Frivolous/vexatious-litigant complaint; no standing; never reached merits of FHA disability pleading.
FHA failure-to-accommodate lacked necessity link; retaliation lacked adverse action; § 504 lacked disability-nexus; due process survived.

source_file: 10772814_2026_Karen Sam _ Robert Sam v. Dekalb Housing Authority, et al._ilnd
notes: Plaintiffs did not connect alleged wrongs to disability or allege discriminatory intent/impact under FHA.
FHA claim fails because plaintiff did not plead a request for accommodation tied to disability; ADA/§1983 claims time-barred.

source_file: 11267621 - Gilbert v. TUCSON REALTY & TRUST COMPANY
notes: Plaintiff failed on multiple elements of reasonable accommodation claim including substantial limitation, knowledge, and necessity/causation.

source_file: 7230918_2015_Holy Ghost Revival Ministries v. City of Marysville_wawd
notes: Amended complaint contained no allegations about what accommodation was proposed, whether it was reasonable, or how handicap deprived residents of opportunity to use dwellings.
TAC removed specific limiting condition; only conclusory 'handicapped' label; no factual allegations showing substantial limitation of major life activity; amendment held futile.

source_file: 9600205_2021_Melton v. Regional Center of the East Bay, Inc._cand
notes: FHA claim against Arleen's dismissed without prejudice for failure to exhaust administrative remedies under Lanterman Act; reached merits on ADA/504 only as to state department.
§ 3617 harassment/retaliation claims fail because bank statement requests and inspections were lawful regulatory activity, not adverse action or protected activity; no disability claim pleaded.

Pro se plaintiff asserted disability-based FHA claim but 'not alleged any information regarding a disability or how she was discriminated against based on a disability'; retaliation claim also failed.
Dismissed on res judicata and Rooker-Feldman grounds; § 3604 disparate treatment prima facie also lacked elements 2-4, but gatekeeping doctrines dispositive.

Disability discrimination/failure-to-accommodate dismissed because defendant offered comparable units and no animus pleaded; retaliation and harassment dismissed for lack of adverse action/protected activity; race/sex claims survived.

source_file: 9795430_2020_Thompson v. Morgan Properties Management Company, LLC_ned
notes: Not a pleading-failure outcome; plaintiff had ramp throughout, defendants ultimately installed permanent ramp—no injury in fact; standing dismissal turned on factual record, not pleading defect.

FHA disability claim failed for lack of facts establishing disability within meaning of statute and no facts showing service animal necessary as accommodation; sexual orientation claim also dismissed.
FHA claim time-barred under 2-year limitations period; no equitable tolling available; no disability-specific analysis reached.

source_file: 9874632_2022_Mercer v. New York City Housing Authority_nysd
notes: Pro se complaint raised lead-paint/§1983 claims but court liberally construed for possible FHA disability theory; 'no facts plausibly suggesting a viable FHA claim'; leave to amend granted.

source_file: 9891340_2024_Ball v. Hope East of Fifth HDFC Inc._nysd
notes: Pro se plaintiff alleges 'physically disabled' without specifying disability; no facts showing disability motivated landlord's refusal to transfer/repair; FHA and Rehab Act claims dismissed with leave to amend.
§ 3604(c) claim fails because landlord statements about access/ESA records were not discriminatory; no statement indicating preference or limitation based on disability or family status.
Brief order dismissing FHA claims without prejudice along with § 1983; reasoning in separate memorandum not included in file; treated as pleading-insufficiency translation failure.
Shotgun pleading citing § 3604 alongside many statutes; scant factual allegations insufficient under Rule 8; sua sponte dismissal without prejudice.

Hoarding disorder not pleaded as 'substantially limiting major life activity'; fails first element of all FHA theories; alternatively fails intentional discrimination, retaliation, accommodation, and hostile environment elements.
